read.en: Micron fell 7.6% on Nov 16 to $719.02, trading $716.38–739.12. It is below the 5-day ($766.4), 10-day ($756.2), 200-day ($767.1), 30-day ($878.1) and 100-day ($938.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram widening again after nearly closing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($861.12), and RSI is 38.0.
read.zh: 美光 11月16日下跌 7.6%，收于 $719.02，盘中区间 $716.38–739.12。股价位于 5 日（$766.4）、10 日（$756.2）、200 日（$767.1）、30 日（$878.1）和 100 日均线（$938.1）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图在几乎收拢后再度放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$861.12），RSI 为 38.0。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports ($725–770), including the 200-day, now resistance. Resistance is $725.1–739.1 (Nov 10 close, Jul 29 low, Nov 16 high), then $744.7–756.2 (Nov 9–10 highs, Nov 13 low, 10-day) and $766.4–767.1 (5 and 200-day). Support is $699.6 (Nov 10 low), then $689.7–690 (Nov 9 low, Nov 6 close) and $650–656.4 (Nov 5). A close above $739.1 would target $750–756; below $699.6, $690.
